description: This Java class FuelTunePane manages user interface and logic for tuning fuel maps in an automotive ECU tuning application. It includes UI components for displaying and editing fuel tables, handling data collection, performing auto-tuning iterations, and uploading results to the controller.

classes.name: FuelDataPoint
classes.description: Encapsulates a data point with RPM, engine load, and AFR values, and computes corresponding indices in the VE map.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads table data from byte array content starting at specified offset.

methods.name: initTable
methods.description: Initializes a Table3D object with size, scales, and border.

methods.name: doJob
methods.description: Performs auto-tuning iteration: loads current VE map, triggers auto-tune processing, updates change map, and enables upload.

methods.name: writeDataPoints
methods.description: Logs data points to auto-tune log file.

methods.name: logMap
methods.description: Logs a 2D map to the auto-tune log file.

methods.name: getTuneLogStream
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the DataOutputStream for logging auto-tune process.

methods.name: toByteArray
methods.description: Converts a 2D double array to a byte array, representing the map data.

methods.name: showContent
methods.description: Sets up sensor listener for data collection and loads VE table data for UI.

methods.name: reloadVeTable
methods.description: Reloads VE table content from the ECU.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Loads a 2D map array from byte array content.

methods.name: loadArray
methods.description: Loads float array from byte buffer for a specified offset.
